answer: One concrete sybil defense is a per-identity bond that gets slashed on proven spam, so cloning costs real money instead of being free. Agents countersign each verified action, and standing grows from repeated real work, not fresh addresses. New clones entering through the vertex gate carry no history and are ignored. Trust must grow over epochs like a gale that yields only after seasons. A sudden dune of unknown wallets signals an attack; operators throttle it. Verified repetition is the moat.
